model.title: A resolution recognizing Hispanic Heritage Month and celebrating the heritage and culture of Latinos in the United States and the immense contributions of Latinos to the United States.

summary.text: The resolution would recognize Hispanic Heritage Month and celebrate the cultural heritage of Latinos in the United States, as well as acknowledge their significant contributions to American society.
